contexts.text: The holy city, which is also called the holy Jerusalem = the Lord's Kingdom in universal, or in each person in particular. In like manner the city, or mount of Zion; the latter = what is celestial of faith, the former, what is spiritual of faith. What is celestial and spiritual itself is also described by cities, etc. Illustrated.
As the celestial and spiritual things of faith are represented by a city, so all doctrinal things are signified by the cities of Judah and Israel...
The city has no need of the sun.
The holy city.
Hence the city of God, and the holy city = faith in the Lord.
As a city, or city = faith...
The holy city = the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom. AC 5044:8.
When this truth inflows into the first Heaven... it appears as a paradise, and elsewhere as a city containing palaces.
The holy city, and the New Jerusalem = the Church.
A city = the truth of the Church. References.
The truths and goods with a man form as it were a city; hence the man himself, in whom is the Church, is called the city of God.
A house, with its chambers, etc., is a city in the least form.
The city which shall be inhabited for ever () is not Jerusalem, but is the Lord's Church, which is signified by Jerusalem.
There appeared to me a great city...
Arranged in the form of a city.
The city Jerusalem descending from God out of heaven = its heavenly doctrine revealed by the Lord.
As men dwell in cities...
As from a village into a great city...
The holy city = the doctrine of Divine truth from the Lord.
As in a city, commonwealth, and kingdom...
The holy city they shall tread under foot forty-two months () = that it will disperse all the truth of the Word until there is not anything remaining.
The holy city, or city = means the holy Jerusalem... To tread that city under foot = to disperse the truths of its doctrine.
An extensive and spacious city (of the copper age in Heaven). Described.
The ascent is by means of stairs from one city into the other.
The name of the city of my God () = the doctrine of the New Church.
The city of my God = the doctrine of Divine truth. Explained.
